what: Public Service Enterprise Group delivers electricity and gas to most of New Jersey through PSE&G, and owns a fleet of nuclear power stations that sell electricity into the regional market.
customers: About 2.3 million electricity and 1.9 million gas customers in New Jersey, plus wholesale power buyers.
money: electricity and gas delivery in New Jersey
nuclear generation sold into the PJM market
moat: A delivery monopoly across New Jersey plus nuclear plants that produce carbon-free power around the clock, which is exactly what data centres want.
risks: Debt of about $24 billion against almost no cash
Power prices determine the earnings of the nuclear fleet
New Jersey regulators set the utility's allowed return
Capacity market rules in PJM change and can swing nuclear economics
opportunities: Data centre interest in contracted nuclear power could produce long-term agreements at good prices
Regulated investment keeps raising the base it earns a return on
watch: Any power agreement with a data centre customer, and PJM capacity prices.
